messages.content:
You are AutoSkill's Document Skill Compiler.
Task: consolidate support-backed document counseling assets into canonical reusable skills.
Output ONLY strict JSON parseable by json.loads.
Decision policy:
- Be conservative and prefer fewer, better canonical skills over many near-duplicates.
- Treat each canonical skill as a reusable contract: when to invoke it, when not to invoke it, what it executes, and what output or handoff it guarantees.
- Keep distinct parent/child assets separate even when they come from the same section.
Merge drafts only when they express the same reusable capability after de-duplication and abstraction.
Never merge drafts across different asset_type, granularity, or asset_node_id.
Keep distinct skills separate when invocation boundary, objective, method, stage, guardrails, or deliverable differs materially.
Preserve multi-granularity outputs: macro_protocol, session_skill, micro_skill, safety_rule, knowledge_reference.
Each output skill should stay single-goal, with one primary objective, one primary stage, and one primary method family.
Every output skill must reference support_ids grounded in the provided drafts/supports.
support_ids must be chosen only from the provided supports.
source_draft_ids must be chosen only from the provided drafts.
When asset_node_id is present, it must stay inside the configured taxonomy and match the output asset layer.
Do not invent routing cues, workflow steps, constraints, output guarantees, or examples that are not supported by the provided drafts/supports.
Return JSON as {"skills": [...]}.
Fields per skill:
- name, description, prompt
- asset_type, asset_node_id, granularity, objective
- domain, task_family, method_family, stage
- applicable_signals, intervention_moves, contraindications
- triggers, workflow_steps, constraints, cautions, output_contract, examples, tags
- confidence, risk_class
- support_ids: array of support ids backing this canonical skill
- source_draft_ids: array of source draft ids merged into this skill
- optional resources/files with safe relative paths only
Do not add facts unsupported by the provided drafts/supports.

{"drafts": [{"draft_id": "e619efeb-0752-5917-a34e-67e7cc694436", "doc_id": "746b8660-57be-5a86-bc5c-fdd89bdae86d", "name": "Feed 存储 URI 参数化配置", "description": "使用 %(name)s、%(time)s 等占位符及 spider 参数构造 Feed 存储 URI，实现按 spider 或时间分目录导出。适用于需要将抓取结果写入 FTP/S3 等存储并做目录隔离的场景。", "asset_type": "micro_skill", "granularity": "micro", "asset_node_id": "micro_skill_node", "asset_path": "family_root/macro_skill/workflow_skill/micro_skill_node", "asset_level": 3, "visible_role": "leaf", "objective": "生成带占位符的 Feed 存储 URI，实现按 spider/时间分目录导出", "domain": "scrapy", "task_family": "feed_export", "method_family": "uri_templating", "stage": "配置", "applicable_signals": ["需要按 spider 或时间分目录存放导出文件", "需要将 Feed 写入 FTP 或 S3 等远程存储"], "contraindications": ["仅需本地单文件导出且无需目录隔离"], "intervention_moves": ["选择存储协议与基础路径", "插入 %(name)s 实现按 spider 隔离", "插入 %(time)s 实现按时间隔离", "追加文件名与格式后缀", "如需动态值，引用 spider 参数（作为 spider 属性）"], "workflow_steps": ["确定存储协议与基础路径", "插入 %(name)s 和/或 %(time)s 占位符", "指定导出文件名与格式后缀", "如需动态值，引用 spider 参数", "输出最终 URI 模板"], "triggers": ["需要按 spider 或时间分目录存放导出文件", "需要将 Feed 写入 FTP 或 S3 等远程存储"], "constraints": ["占位符需与 spider 属性名一致", "spider 参数会成为 spider 属性，可作为 URI 参数引用"], "cautions": ["远程存储 URI 中可能包含凭据，注意避免泄露"], "output_contract": ["可用的参数化存储 URI 模板（如 ftp://.../%(name)s/%(time)s.json）"], "examples": [{"input": "FTP 存储，按 spider 分目录", "output": "ftp://user:password@ftp.example.com/scraping/feeds/%(name)s/%(time)s.json", "notes": ""}, {"input": "S3 存储，按 spider 分目录", "output": "s3://mybucket/scraping/feeds/%(name)s/%(time)s.json", "notes": ""}], "risk_class": "low", "confidence": 0.7, "support_ids": ["c0747914-b67b-51ab-98ed-14261db6d75a"], "metadata": {"prompt": "根据目标存储类型（FTP、S3 等）与目录隔离需求，构造带占位符的 Feed 存储 URI 模板。
1. 确定存储协议与基础路径（如 ftp://user:password@host/path 或 s3://bucket/path）。
2. 在路径中插入占位符以实现隔离：按 spider 用 %(name)s，按时间用 %(time)s。
3. 指定导出文件名与格式后缀（如 .json）。
4. 若需使用 spider 参数，记住 spider 参数会成为 spider 属性，因此可作为存储 URI 参数引用。
5. 输出最终 URI 模板字符串，供 FEEDS 配置使用。", "tags": ["scrapy", "feed-export", "uri-templating", "storage"], "files": {}, "resources": {}, "source_sections": ["Feed exports"], "extraction_unit": "window", "domain_type": "scrapy", "taxonomy_id": "scrapy", "asset_node_id": "micro_skill_node", "asset_path": "family_root/macro_skill/workflow_skill/micro_skill_node", "asset_level": 3, "visible_role": "leaf", "candidate_slot": 1, "window_id": "601fd9d3-3489-5cf6-90f1-00e4a49d0fe5", "window_strategy": "strict", "anchor_hits": [], "paragraph_start": 19, "paragraph_end": 21, "heading_path": ["Feed exports"], "parent_heading": "", "sibling_headings": ["input001\feed-exports.md"], "subsection_headings": ["Serialization formats", "JSON", "JSON lines", "CSV", "XML", "Pickle", "Marshal", "Storages", "Storage URI parameters", "Local filesystem", "FTP", "S3", "Google Cloud Storage (GCS)", "Standard output", "Delayed file delivery", "Item filtering", "ItemFilter", "Post-Processing", "Built-in Plugins", "Custom Plugins", "Settings", "FEEDS", "FEED_EXPORT_ENCODING", "FEED_EXPORT_FIELDS", "FEED_EXPORT_INDENT", "FEED_STORE_EMPTY", "FEED_STORAGES", "FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE", "FEED_STORAGE_S3_ACL", "FEED_STORAGES_BASE", "FEED_EXPORTERS", "FEED_EXPORTERS_BASE", "FEED_EXPORT_BATCH_ITEM_COUNT", "FEED_URI_PARAMS"], "context_snippets": [], "heading_number": "", "heading_kind": "outline_llm", "section_summary": "One of the most frequently required features when implementing scrapers is"}}], "supports": [{"support_id": "c0747914-b67b-51ab-98ed-14261db6d75a", "doc_id": "746b8660-57be-5a86-bc5c-fdd89bdae86d", "section": "Feed exports", "excerpt": "Here are some examples to illustrate:

- Store in FTP using one directory per spider:
  - `ftp://user:password@ftp.example.com/scraping/feeds/%(name)s/%(time)s.json`
- Store in S3 using one directory per spider:
  - `s3://mybucket/scraping/feeds/%(name)s/%(time)s.json`
